name: postpartum overwhelm
description: A new parent who feels overwhelmed and tearful, suspects postpartum depression, and asks why they feel so alone. Verifies parenting care, a non-shaming professional-support reply for the depression disclosure, and loneliness care for the isolation question.

turns.text: I just had a baby and I feel overwhelmed and tearful all the time
I think I might have postpartum depression
Why do I feel so alone after having a baby?

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the parenting thread for new-parent overwhelm. Turn 2 keeps the postpartum-depression disclosure on parenting with a supportive, non-shaming reply. Turn 3 answers the isolation question from the loneliness thread.
expected.behavior: Postpartum feelings stay on the parenting thread without diagnosis, and the postpartum loneliness question gets real companionship care.
